description: Committed UI-protocol manifest (feature 044). Single source for the server->client WS frame vocabulary, the ui_event action vocabulary, and the component vocabulary. Backend, Windows, and Android test suites all assert against this file; adding a frame type, action, or component type REQUIRES editing it in the same PR (guards fail otherwise). See specs/044-native-client-parity/contracts/ui-protocol.md.

guidance_notes_088.authority: Presentation capability grants no access. Every request uses the original authenticated human, exact issued session when supplied, current owner and policy; commands require the original write authority and exact expected revision.

request.request_generation: fresh canonical UUID4 per request, including commands and retries
request.identity_duplicates: If present, must exactly match the validated original top-level identity. No other payload metadata is accepted.
request.delivery: Never queue, reconnect-replay, retain form values for retry, or substitute a newer owner/session. Retry after uncertain command delivery opens the current list; it never resubmits the mutation.

fields.value: literal nonempty normalized private text, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes
fields.expiry_date: UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss[.SSS]Z when Set a date is selected; otherwise ignored; Keep current expiry preserves the exact stored integer

web_response.html: shared Projection escaped and sanitized rendering

guidance_notes_088.response_policy: Accept one complete response matching the current surface, request generation, connection and owner. Reject stale, malformed, duplicate, cross-surface and uncorrelated frames. Server rechecks the exact displayed note revisions and expiry after rendering and before delivery.

content.text: Complete literal text; no Markdown interpretation, source-link activation, truncation or private-value logging. Native forms use the same field names, choices, defaults, visibility and exact revision commands.
content.forget: Separate review displays the exact note and revision. Explicit confirmation retires the ciphertext; no undo or historical plaintext view.

work_save_088.authority: Presentation capability grants no access and viewing a result never saves it. The Save result button and the review's approval carry only server-issued bindings; Deep rebuilds the exact public result and destination from its own ledger, re-verifies every digest, revision and destination head under the operation's original session plus the current human caller, and refuses a changed, expired or already-consumed review. A normal submission never implies this approval (FR-005).

navigation.review_reachability: review is rendered only as the host's response to the propose command; it is never a chrome_open destination and its Back button returns to result

state.save: server-issued propose bindings on a result view: submission_id (becomes the proposal's stable action id), publication_id, expected_revision (must equal the displayed operation revision), conversation_id, conversation_title, expected_workspace_revision and expected_workspace_publication_id (null exactly when that revision is 0)
state.review: Deep's review body verbatim: version 1, status review_required, created, revision, proposal {action_id, proposal_digest, publication_id, conversation_id, component_id, base_render_revision, base_publication_id, content_digest, stage_digest, expires_at} and component {component_id, component_type card, title, position, payload}
state.approve: server-issued approval binding {submission_id, expired}; absent when the proposal is not decidable, in which case no Save button renders

content.review: The complete exact component payload is re-rendered verbatim (every passage, caption and source fact); an unknown payload shape makes the whole view unavailable rather than a partial review. Destination and expiry are shown; digests, revisions and heads bind the command and are not explanatory copy.

component_chrome.versions_policy: Inspect only the first five rows; discard unknown fields, invalid numbers and non-string text, omit duplicate version numbers, and truncate plain text by Unicode codepoint limits. Exact integral JSON numbers are accepted; booleans and numeric strings are refused.
component_chrome.identity: original_canonical_component_id; never id-only or dg_/ly_/wel_ or divider/skeleton
component_chrome.policy: Projection builds the inventory from original stored type, current host flags and receiver profile; Deep overwrites outbound copies after adaptation without persistence. Metadata never authorizes execution.
component_chrome.execution: Capture and recheck current owner/session/chat/component and required action context. Existing refine/restore, authenticated CSV and component share gates remain authoritative; never execute descriptor URLs, events or parameters.
component_chrome.live_canvas: Outside timeline/read-only mode; do not add an unrelated busy visibility rule.
component_chrome.owned_chat: Existing owned-chat CSV and component Share semantics also apply while viewing timeline history; downloaded/shared content comes from the existing authorized endpoint.

dispositions.web: same existing DOM and server flags

component_chrome.legacy_server: Updated native clients hide component actions when metadata is absent; no inferred flags or legacy canvas-export fallback.
component_chrome.legacy_clients: May ignore additive metadata and retain historical inferred menus; server authorization/flag denials are unchanged.

workspace_action.live_canvas: Outside timeline with a mounted dynamic renderer and the matching server canvas capability; no additional busy or positive-revision visibility predicate.
workspace_action.execution: Descriptor presence is not authorization. Capture and recheck the owner, chat and current canvas revision as applicable around the existing authenticated operation. Never execute an arbitrary descriptor URL, surface or payload.

watch_disposition.reason: The wrist retains its existing chrome-free, no-file-IO profile; canvas export/share and component artifact verbs are absent.
watch_disposition.continuation: Use the same owned chat on a supported phone, desktop or web client. Preserve existing server-provided handoff guidance where present; omission creates no button, URL, token or share snapshot.

disposition_matrix_088.purpose: One server-owned table naming, for every feature-088 destination, what each client actually receives (FR-023/FR-024). A destination a client cannot complete is declared here with an explicit disposition; a client never hides a control to simulate parity, and no row adds a primitive type, push type or action to the manifest.

dispositions.supported: The client receives the complete server-built view with every declared control intact; adaptation drops nothing.
dispositions.read_only_handoff: The client receives the readable content without its controls plus a server-declared continuation; it never renders a partial command form or a partial effect review.
dispositions.omitted_by_server: The host never delivers this destination to this client. No control, URL, token or snapshot is created, and the omission is declared here rather than inferred.
dispositions.version_required: The destination exists but the host withholds it until the client advertises the row contract's client_capability in register_ui.capabilities.

bases.web_render_channel: Web is the authoritative chrome_render channel; every 088 destination is built and rendered there first (server-owned web-first disposition).
bases.advertised_capability: The client's register_ui frame advertises the row contract's client_capability.
bases.missing_capability: The client's register_ui frame does not advertise the row contract's client_capability, so the host withholds the destination.
bases.contract_declared: A sentence or list in this manifest, named by contract_path, states the disposition.
bases.shared_chrome_menu: The control rides the shared chrome_menu model with no capability gate; every client that renders chrome_menu receives it.
bases.watch_menu_projection: webrender.chrome.menu_model.project_watch_menu_model does not project this control to the wrist.
bases.owner_exclusion_T059: Windows keeps its existing compatible layout; the feature-088 redesign is excluded by the owner's 2026-09-11 decision (T059).
bases.rote_voice_profile: backend/rote/capabilities.py gives the voice profile supports_interactivity False, so ComponentAdapter drops every action; a command surface cannot be completed by voice.

voice.note: a ROTE rendering profile of an already registered client, not a separate registration

disposition_matrix_088.effect_review_policy: A row marked effect_review is an authorization step. It is delivered complete or not at all: read_only_handoff is never a valid disposition for one, so no client can execute a review it only partly rendered (FR-023).
disposition_matrix_088.vocabulary: no new push type, component type, accept_action or client_local_action

additive_fields.scope: Optional per-dimension charge basis. A dimension may be absent; absent is not "none", and "none" is not a zero amount. An unrecognized token makes the Work view unavailable rather than rendering an unknown basis as a known one.
Optional quoted currency for monetary amounts. When absent the owner view continues to say the currency is unavailable; the client never invents or converts one.

shape.observed_interval_ms: non-negative integer or null when unknown
shape.elapsed_ms: non-negative integer or null when unknown

additive_fields.scope: Optional timing read model for one operation. Absent means no measurement is disclosed; no attempt count, interval sum or elapsed union is ever synthesized for an operation whose host supplies none, and null is unknown, never zero.
proof-bound final transcript only; absent preserves ordinary typed chat semantics
watch-profile sockets only; absent when the rendition is unspeakable
present when the stream is bridged to a workspace component identity; absent on legacy/narrative streams
authenticated desktop host advertisement; the client never supplies host_session_id
fresh equality fence for one WebSocket connection attempt
fresh equality fence for one hydration or commit request
owner-validated active chat; operation_status uses explicit null for surface-only work
disposable preview overlay; must equal the current committed revision
strictly increasing within a chat/connection/request overlay generation
immutable candidate-owned applicability; missing or malformed is blocking
